proposals.before: Zhang Hongce, styled Zhenjian, came from Fangcheng in Fanyang—a maternal cousin of Empress Wenxian.
proposals.after: Zhang Hongce, styled Zhenjian, came from Fangcheng in Fanyang—a younger paternal cousin of Empress Wenxian.
proposals.reason: Chinese 從父弟 means younger paternal cousin (father's brother's son), not maternal cousin.

proposals.before: Zhang Hongce, styled Zhenjian, was a native of Fangcheng in Fanyang, a younger cousin on his mother's side of Empress Wenxian.
proposals.after: Zhang Hongce, styled Zhenjian, was a native of Fangcheng in Fanyang, a younger paternal cousin of Empress Wenxian.
proposals.reason: Chinese 從父弟 is paternal-line cousinage, not "on his mother's side".

proposals.before: At Yangkou, Emperor He sent imperial censor Zong Yun to comfort the armies.
proposals.after: At Yangkou, Emperor He sent imperial censor Zong Guai to comfort the armies.
proposals.reason: Chinese 宗夬 is Zong Guai (夬), not Zong Yun.

proposals.before: At Yangkou, Emperor He sent imperial censor Zong Yun to comfort the armies.
proposals.after: At Yangkou, Emperor He sent imperial censor Zong Guai to comfort the armies.
proposals.reason: Chinese 宗夬 is Zong Guai, not Zong Yun.

proposals.before: Yu pressed Yun: "Without the yellow battle-ax you cannot command the lords."
proposals.after: Yu pressed Guai: "Without the yellow battle-ax you cannot command the lords."
proposals.reason: Person 宗夬 was mistranslated as Yun; use Guai.

proposals.before: Yu pressed Yun: "Without the yellow battle-ax you cannot command the lords."
proposals.after: Yu pressed Guai: "Without the yellow battle-ax you cannot command the lords."
proposals.reason: Person 宗夬 was mistranslated as Yun; use Guai.

proposals.before: Yun went back to the western headquarters, and the yellow battle-ax was given to Gaozu at once.
proposals.after: Guai went back to the western headquarters, and the yellow battle-ax was given to Gaozu at once.
proposals.reason: Person 夬/宗夬 was mistranslated as Yun; use Guai.

proposals.before: Yun went back to the western headquarters, and the yellow battle-ax was given to Gaozu at once.
proposals.after: Guai went back to the western headquarters, and the yellow battle-ax was given to Gaozu at once.
proposals.reason: Person 夬/宗夬 was mistranslated as Yun; use Guai.

proposals.before: Inspector Xiao Yan's younger brother Shen had been put to death; when court troops came to take Yan, his attendants fled in panic, but Shaoshu alone rode to him at the news.
proposals.after: Inspector Xiao Dan's younger brother Shen had been put to death; when court troops came to take Dan, his attendants fled in panic, but Shaoshu alone rode to him at the news.
proposals.reason: Chinese 蕭誕 is Xiao Dan, not Xiao Yan (which is Gaozu's personal name).

proposals.before: When the righteous army rose, he became General of the Champions, then General of Valiant Cavalry, and marched east to Jiangzhou; Shaoshu stayed to govern the province and supply Jiang and Xiang with grain, without a single lapse.
proposals.after: When the righteous army rose, Shaoshu was made General of the Champions, then General of Valiant Cavalry; accompanying the eastern advance to Jiangzhou, he was left to oversee the province and supervise grain transport for Jiang and Xiang, without a single lapse.
proposals.reason: The biography subject is Shaoshu: 爲冠軍將軍… refers to him, and 留紹叔 marks that he was left to govern, not a different actor who marched while Shaoshu stayed.

proposals.before: Posthumously: Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry and General of the Guards, with martial music, Eastern Garden rites, court robes, a full suit, and whatever the funeral demands supplied at need.
proposals.after: Posthumously: Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry and General of the Guards, with one set of martial music, Eastern Garden burial vessels, one court robe, one suit of garments, and whatever the funeral required supplied as needed.
proposals.reason: 東園秘器 are Eastern Garden burial vessels/coffins, not rites; the literal field already reflects this.
諡 denotes a posthumous name, not a temple name; the literal field already translates correctly.

proposals.before: Gaozu already held Yongzhou; Sengzhen begged to go west and was made Magistrate of Zou.
proposals.after: Gaozu already held Yongzhou; Sengzhen begged to go west and was made Magistrate of Qi.
proposals.reason: 邔 is the county Qi (pinyin Qǐ), not Zou; the magistracy is 邔令.

proposals.before: By then Gaozu already held Yongzhou; Sengzhen pressed hard to return west and was appointed Magistrate of Zou.
proposals.after: By then Gaozu already held Yongzhou; Sengzhen pressed hard to return west and was appointed Magistrate of Qi.
proposals.reason: 邔令 is Magistrate of Qi county; Zou misreads the place name.

proposals.before: The army stopped at Jiangning; Gaozu sent Sengzhen and Wang Mao with elite troops to take Red Nose Ford first.
proposals.after: The army stopped at Jiangning; Gaozu sent Sengzhen and Wang Mao with elite troops to take the Red Nose picket first.
proposals.reason: 赤鼻邏 is a picket/patrol post (邏), not a ford.

proposals.before: The great host halted at Jiangning; Gaozu ordered Sengzhen and Wang Mao to lead picked troops to seize the Red Nose Ford first.
proposals.after: The great host halted at Jiangning; Gaozu ordered Sengzhen and Wang Mao to lead picked troops to seize the Red Nose picket first.
proposals.reason: 赤鼻邏 denotes a picket post, not a ford.

proposals.before: When Qi's Prince of Sui Zilong went to Jing as inspector, Qi Wudi made Sengzhen his guard captain on the march to the province.
proposals.after: When Qi's Prince of Sui, Zilong, went to Jing as inspector, Qi Wudi made Sengzhen his guard captain on the march to the province.
proposals.reason: English fuses the title and given name; a comma is needed after Sui as in the literal.

proposals.before: Chen Minister of Personnel Yao Cha said: Zhang Hongce was steady and careful, Lü Sengzhen tireless in duty, and Zheng Shaoshu loyal and upright; in founding the dynasty all three gave real force.
proposals.after: Yao Cha, Minister of Personnel of Chen, said: Zhang Hongce was steady and careful, Lü Sengzhen tireless in duty, and Zheng Shaoshu loyal and upright; in founding the dynasty all three gave real force.
proposals.reason: 陳吏部尚書姚察 marks Yao Cha as Chen's Minister of Personnel; the fused 'Chen Minister of Personnel Yao Cha' reads as if Chen modifies the office title awkwardly in English.

decisions.reason: 從父弟 is younger paternal cousin (father’s brother’s son); maternal cousin misreads 從父 as maternal line.
從父弟 marks paternal-line cousinage; “on his mother’s side” invents a maternal reading absent from 從父.
宗夬 is Zong Guai (夬 guài); Yun would require 雲 and is a wrong reading of the given name.
Same name error on the literal field: 宗夬 is Guai, not Yun.
域乃諷夬曰 addresses 夬 (Guai); continuing Yun repeats the 宗夬 misreading.
Literal likewise must render 夬 as Guai, the same person as 宗夬 in s0080.
夬反西臺 continues 宗夬; subject is Guai returning west, not Yun.
Literal must match: 夬 is Guai’s given name, carried from 宗夬.
刺史蕭誕 is Xiao Dan (誕); Yan confuses him with Gaozu’s personal name 衍, and s0101 already has Dan.
Unstated 爲冠軍將軍…侍從東下江州 is Shaoshu; 留紹叔監州事 then leaves him to oversee—original splits one actor into two.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 爲冠軍將軍，改驍騎將軍，侍從東下江州，留紹叔監州事

decisions.reason: 東園秘器 are Eastern Garden burial vessels/coffins, not rites; 鼓吹一部/朝服一具/衣一襲 also support the counted wording.
諡曰忠 is a posthumous name (諡); temple name would be 廟號.
邔令 is magistrate of Qi (邔 Qǐ); Zou misreads a different place name.
Literal must likewise render 邔 as Qi, not Zou.
赤鼻邏 uses 邏 ‘picket/patrol post,’ not a ford (津/渡).
Literal likewise: 邏 is a picket, so ‘Ford’ invents a crossing.
Comma after Sui is only punctuation polish; ‘Prince of Sui Zilong’ already names 隨王子隆 accurately enough.
Reordering to ‘Yao Cha, Minister of Personnel of Chen’ is stylistic; ‘Chen Minister of Personnel Yao Cha’ already conveys 陳吏部尚書姚察.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 爲冠軍將軍，改驍騎將軍

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0015 restores 邏 as a picket; c0765’s action ‘seized-ford’ still encodes the bad ford reading and must become seized-picket.
